_readme: Source of truth for events.html. Add a new event by copying an existing object. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Events dated today or later show under Upcoming; earlier dates move to Past Events automatically. Set "status" to "upcoming" or "past" to override. Set "registration" to null when there is no sign-up link, and "recording" to null when there is no video.

events.title: Fireside Chat with Severin Hacker (Duolingo)
events.speaker: Severin Hacker
events.description: Join us for a conversation with Severin Hacker, co-founder and CTO of Duolingo — the CMU-born company that became the world's most popular way to learn a language. This event is exclusive to 99 Tartans members and CMU students & alumni.

events.title: Fireside Chat featuring Aurora Innovation
events.speaker: Chris Urmson
events.description: Aurora develops autonomous driving technology — most notably for heavy-duty freight trucks through its Aurora Driver system. The conversation covered how Aurora is bringing hardware, software, and AI together to make freight transportation safer, more efficient, and more reliable.
